_provenance.why_this_file_exists: phase_03_gate predicate g04_p07 (all_partners_in_tier3) requires every partner assigned as a lead or contributor in wp_structure.json to exist in this file. The registry is derived from roles.json and introduces no entity, name, country or role that is not already in roles.json.
_provenance.instrument_note: MSCA-PF is a single-fellow, single-beneficiary action, not a consortium. 'Partner' here means an identifier the work-package structure references, not a consortium beneficiary. Only HOST is a beneficiary legal entity.
_provenance.token_coverage: Every role token the draft work plan references is present. The §3.1 month lines name MATE, ELTE, MVCRI and AgroVIR (¶253, ¶264, ¶276, ¶289, ¶303), which map to DATA_PARTNER, HOST, TRANSFER_PARTNER and VALIDATION_PARTNER. FELLOW executes all work packages, and FELLOW plus SUPERVISOR own deliverable D1.3. CO_SUPERVISOR carries WP3 and WP4 supervisory responsibility per input pack item 7.
_provenance.unresolved_scope: MATE, MVCRI and AgroVIR carry no legal name, PIC, address or contact person. Those fields are absent from the draft and await the ticket 6 fold of input pack items 1 and 2. No value is guessed.

partners.note: Draft-confirmed: short name, country, function and work-plan role. Missing and not guessed: full registered legal name, PIC, entity type, registered address and contact person (input pack item 1, blocking), and participation mode (item 2, blocking). Item 1 records AgroVIR's PIC as confirmed absent and states that phase_03_gate predicate g04_p07 fails on it. That reading is wrong, and the correction is recorded in the lift decision-log entry: g04_p07 (runner/predicates/coverage_predicates.py, all_partners_in_tier3) tests whether every WP-assigned partner id appears in this file, and reads no PIC. The token is present, so the gate passes. The absent PIC blocks submission instead, because AgroVIR hosts the non-academic placement and therefore goes in Part A, where every participant needs one. Ticket 6 folds the answers; the PIC itself can only come from the EU Participant Register.
